_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/MandrelStation/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, controller cell at [0,0,0]: the stump, nearest the player who placed it; the mandrel points south. A hand station: no power cell. work is the forging of one hollow, W 0..1 (blows struck over blows needed), or the winding of one spring (wind); k is the job: the hollow's metal (1 lead, 2 copper) or 3 a spring; gauge windows are placed in work units. theta is the hammer's (or the held right-click's) clock, carried by a ratio-0 rotate on the mandrel. See the mandrel station's README for the schema.

forge._comment: blowsPerHollow: the pace, hammer blows (right-clicks) a hollow; copper half as much again. hollows: each class's work. sections: what a hollow makes, sectionsPerHollow of them.

wind._comment: The spring job: rod is its work, of its own class 3 (its parts, requires rodsteel, move for that class alone), wound over W 0..1, the rod laid along the mandrel and wound round it from its shoulder end a side at a time, each laid behind the tip (the wire's bend) as it goes round; turnsPerRod: the pace, turns of the held right-click's clock (a turn a second) a rod. spring: what a rod makes, springsPerRod of them. hot: the requires values whose parts are drawn hot, with vanilla's glow by the rod's temperature.
